words.def: the process of teaching and learning, usually at school or university
a school that is paid for by the government, so parents pay no fees
a school that parents pay fees to send their children to
a test you have to pass before a school or university accepts you
a mark that shows how good a piece of work is
the qualification you receive when you finish a university course
a document showing that you have completed a course of study
an exam or a course you have passed, which you can show to an employer
a series of lessons on one subject
expecting people to obey the rules exactly
the study of numbers, shapes and measurements
the study of the physical world through experiments and observation
written works such as novels, plays and poems, studied as a subject
a choice that you make after thinking about it
the result you get when you achieve what you wanted
to teach someone the skills they need for a job

steps.prompt: Look at sentences 3 and 4. What is the difference?
